thesis: This episode identifies specific marketplace startups as digital alternatives for home consumption, noting that Uber Eats competes alongside DoorDash and Instacart. It also highlights how Airbnb adjusted its business model from halted travel to near-term trips, while drawing a comparison between Masterclass's social prestige and Netflix.
